records.description: Store this as an Anachronia account unlock. Do not stack it with obsolete aura assumptions from Catalyst-era guides.
records.name: Totem of Vitality

records.description: Keep Warforge as a location dependency until the planner has a sourced Equilibrium locality mapping; do not force it into a region from physical-map intuition.
records.name: Fury of the Small

records.description: Treat this as an unlock candidate, not a recommendation. Other account or League passives can overlap its out-of-combat adrenaline role.
records.name: Persistent Rage

records.description: Treat Anachronia dinosaur-roar supply and rune access as ingredient pressure; no regional hard gate is inferred from the Herblore level itself.
records.name: Vulnerability bomb

records.description: Bait and Switch is unlocked via Evil Bob's Catspaw from offering an Orthen Dig Site death mask (99 Archaeology self-source) to Bob the cat; once harnessed it auto-cooks fish at 50% Cooking XP while fishing. Planners often treat fishing methods as region-local and miss that the permanent dual-skill relic is hard-gated by Anachronia Archaeology.
records.name: Bait and Switch (Orthen death mask + 99 Archaeology)

records.description: Brush pieces drop in the Warped Depths of the Daemonheim Dig Site (Forinthry); restoration is taught by Sharrigan outside Anachronia Base Camp. Already a documented cross-region Archaeology off-hand but easy for single-region Archaeology scoring to miss.
records.name: Balarak's sash brush (Daemonheim pieces + Anachronia restore)

records.description: Lady Ithell upgrades dragon-tier tools with harmonic dust in Prifddinas: hatchet/pickaxe need dragon hatchet/pickaxe, hammer needs a dragon hammer, mattock needs a dragon mattock (Anachronia Big Game Hunter), and the crystal fishing rod is a separate urchin-point unlock. Planners that treat 'crystal tools' as Tirannwn-only miss the dragon-base sourcing pressure.
records.name: Crystal tools (dragon base + Prifddinas)

records.description: Finished t90 hatchet needs crystal hatchet (Prif + dragon hatchet), Imcando hatchet (Woodcutter's Grove / Fort → Misthalin working taxonomy), and Shard of the Lumberjack (Wilfred north of Falador, Asgarnia). Dragon hatchet self-source commonly pulls Fremennik Dagannoth Kings. Bloom and Blight inherits the full chain plus tier-100 Ramarno/moonstone progression.
records.name: Hatchet of Ember and Glade (and Bloom and Blight follow-on)

records.description: Artisans Workshop masterwork melee plate / glorious-bar infrastructure (Asgarnia) feeds skilling off-hands like Orthen furnace core and broader masterwork material chains. Masterwork staff already maps multi-region weapon essence pressure; masterwork ranged materials pull Havenhythe Hunter/Crafting. Skilling-relevant masterwork is not a single-region checkbox.
records.name: Masterwork-adjacent artisan gates for skilling

records.description: Orthen furnace core (Anachronia dig-site materials, 99 Smithing / 102 Archaeology) removes Superheat Form prayer drain and stacks with Superheat Form's heat uplift; smithing autoheater (Daemonheim / Forinthry) keeps heat without re-heating. Full AFK smithing and top Firemaking ceilings need all three, and core also consumes curved masterwork plates (Asgarnia Artisans pressure).
records.name: Orthen furnace core + Superheat Form + smithing autoheater stack

records.description: Normal self-sufficient chain fuses Imcando pickaxe (Keldagrim / Lava Flow Mine, Fremennik) with crystal pickaxe (Prifddinas) plus blast fusion hammer and 90 Smithing. Planners that pick only one of Fremennik or Tirannwn cannot finish the tool without trade or League overrides.
records.name: Pickaxe of Earth and Song

records.description: Prayer powders (powder of burials, pulverising, penance, etc.) are ground from Het's Oasis whirligig shells in the Desert. Powder of burials multiplies bone bury XP and powder of pulverising enables inventory bone grinding at Ectofuntus (Morytania), while high-volume bone sources and bonecrusher (Daemonheim / Forinthry) sit in other regions. Desert alone does not complete the Prayer training loop.
records.name: Prayer powder (Desert whirligigs) + multi-region bone sources

records.description: Ring of Kayazu is crafted at an archaeologist's workbench from a moonstone ring + restored Fang of Kayazu (Moonrise Dig Site / Havenhythe mystery The Final Revolution) and grants +80% soul attraction plus 20% double disturbance loot during rituals. Ritual sites themselves are primarily City of Um (Misthalin working taxonomy) and Ungael (Fremennik), so the best ritual ring is a Havenhythe dig-site unlock used outside Havenhythe.
records.name: Ring of Kayazu (Havenhythe) + Necromancy rituals

records.description: Scroll of cleansing (Daemonheim tokens, Forinthry) permanently saves secondaries and speeds mixes; herb bag (Herby Werby spirit points, Anachronia) is the grimy-herb inventory container; botanist + factory outfits (Flash Powder Factory / Taverley, Asgarnia) add XP and 4-dose chance. Optimized no-trade Herblore pulls all three regions, often with Tirannwn crystal flasks for combination potions.
records.name: Scroll of Cleansing / herb bag / botanist-factory Herblore stack

records.description: Journal gate in Warped Depths (Forinthry/Daemonheim Dig Site) must be read before pieces drop from Anachronia activities (Big Game Hunter, Rex Matriarchs, vile blooms, Agility Course). Not Anachronia-only.
records.name: Skeka's hypnowand (Daemonheim journal + Anachronia pieces)

records.description: Skillchompas are caught in Hunter-region camps (e.g. crimson at Desert Quarry, crystal in Prifddinas/Tirannwn, azure polar/Fremennik, lower tiers elsewhere) but consumed to boost Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Divination, and Archaeology anywhere. League builds often score only the Hunter catch region and ignore the multi-skill throughput they enable (or the need to import them).
records.name: Skillchompas hunter regions vs skills used

records.description: High masters are region-placed (Morvran Prifddinas/Tirannwn, Laniakea Anachronia, Mandrith Forinthry, Sumona Desert, Kuradal Ancient Cavern/Kandarin-adjacent) while assigned tasks often require different regions for the actual monsters. Unlocking a master without its task geography (or vice versa) produces blocked or low-value task lists in a no-trade League.
records.name: High Slayer masters vs task monster regions

records.description: Charms are combat/Slayer drops distributed across regions; Forinthry supplies Charming imp + charming moths, Fremennik Waterbirth is a high-volume charm farm, and tertiary ingredients for high pouches are region-locked. No single region owns Summoning supply — charm acquisition, imp, and tertiaries must be planned as multi-region pressure.
records.name: Summoning charms multi-region supply

records.description: Crystal Mask (Seren spell, 90 Magic) and Light Form (Seren prayer, 91 Prayer) both unlock from The Light Within and stack for pickpocket success (15% → 30% with Light Form post-2026). Unlock is Tirannwn-gated, but the payoff is often spent in other regions (Pyramid Plunder, masters, heists). Planners that score only Desert/Morytania thieving miss the Tirannwn spell/prayer pair.
records.name: Thieving Light Form + Crystal Mask

records.description: Time altar sits on Anachronia with no talisman, but the high-throughput Abyss route still uses the Wilderness/Forinthry Mage of Zamorak entrance. Either region alone cannot self-supply efficient Time-rune crafting; Masterwork staff chains also pressure Time runes.
records.name: Time runes via Abyss (Forinthry entrance + Anachronia altar)

records.description: Daemonheim/Dungeoneering already has a hard Forinthry planner dependency. League token multipliers change acquisition speed, not the permanent effect.
records.name: Spirit cape passive

records.description: This improves production throughput; it does not unlock the underlying potion recipes. Keep it separate from recipe ownership and ingredient access.
records.name: Botanist's Workbench

records.description: Construction/Slayer/Raptor/Chapel content tagged misthalin (Catalyst working) while physical location is south-eastern Wilderness edge. Affects Construction, Prayer chapel, Fletching Ranger's Workroom, Crafting Fort smelt loops.
records.name: Fort Forinthry dual taxonomy

records.description: Necromancy rituals, Um chests, Necromantic runecrafting, Underworld Grimoire bone storage all assume Misthalin starting bucket. Correct per Catalyst taxonomy but unconfirmed for Equilibrium boundaries.
records.name: City of Um / Underworld as Misthalin working

records.description: Alaea crablets, golden bamboo, Tavia's fishing rod package under Asgarnia Arc mapping (user rule 2026-07-26).
records.name: The Arc / Uncharted Isles (Asgarnia packaging)

records.description: training-high-value maps Abyss Time runes as forinthry_plus_anachronia; training-current-audit maps Time runes method_region anachronia only. Abyss path needs Forinthry entrance.
records.name: Time runes dual-region inconsistency

records.description: Woodcutting eternal magic trees kandarin_inferred vs Havenhythe nursery; Construction/FM/RC imbuing all depend on eternal magic supply without unified multi-region resource graph.
records.name: Eternal magic multi-home

records.description: Crafting sandstone + Herblore herb tar correctly flag Fremennik Lunar unlock; resource regions partial. Good pattern to extend to Construction Contracts (Lunar NPC Contact).
records.name: Telekinetic Grind multi-region methods

records.description: Primal mining/smithing and Dungeoneering present; Crafteneering, Daemonheim Divination, phasmatite resource dungeon achievement pressure not modelled as Forinthry combos.
records.name: Daemonheim / Forinthry hard rule underused in skill methods

records.description: Ironman guides ban portable workbenches/ranges; app already warns portables for Summoning. Extend explicit no-portable assumptions to Construction, Cooking, Smithing planner text.
records.name: Portables / TH items / DXP

records.description: Construction planks, Firemaking maple/mahogany, Cooking fish, Farming seeds, Summoning dragon food — rarely modelled as Fremennik region combo pressure.
records.name: Managing Miscellania (Fremennik) as silent supply backbone

records.description: Store this as an optional consumable modifier. Do not bake its poison bonus into Weapon poison+++ itself.
records.name: Kwuarm incense sticks

records.description: Apply official Equilibrium quest auto-completion separately. Do not infer a single ED4 region from physical location.
records.name: Infernal Puzzle Box combat progression

records.description: This is a cross-region completion goal, not a reason to create boss strategy data. Region availability should determine whether the achievement is completable in the League.
records.name: Reaper Crew

records.description: Queueing, stalling, target loss and late-adrenaline interactions can change when an action becomes legal or resolves. Rotation choice also depends on strength, cooldowns, weapon requirements, buff windows and scenario-specific DoT behaviour.
records.name: Queueing, stalling, target loss and late-adrenaline interactions can change when an action becomes legal or resolves. Rotation choice also depends on strength, cooldowns, weapon requirements, buff windows and scenario-specific DoT behaviour.

records.name: Archaeology relics are a separate combat-progression layer with unlock requirements and a finite relic-energy budget.

records.name: Several PvME page families were crawled but should not be imported wholesale.

records.description: Essence of Finality stores a weapon special attack and lets that attack be used through the amulet while other equipment is worn.
records.name: Essence of Finality stores a weapon special attack and lets that attack be used through the amulet while other equipment is worn.

records.description: Boss-specific ammo preset pages are not portable League data, but they reveal that ammo choice and ammo effects need their own generic equipment layer.
records.name: Boss-specific ammo preset pages are not portable League data, but they reveal that ammo choice and ammo effects need their own generic equipment layer.

records.description: Invention power comes through augmentation, components, gizmos, perks, item levels and Ancient Invention. Perks occupy constrained weapon/armour gizmo slots and compete for those slots.
records.name: Invention power comes through augmentation, components, gizmos, perks, item levels and Ancient Invention. Perks occupy constrained weapon/armour gizmo slots and compete for those slots.

records.description: PvME warns site-wide that most content predating the March 2, 2026 Combat Modernization is outdated.
records.name: PvME warns site-wide that most content predating the March 2, 2026 Combat Modernization is outdated.

records.description: Non-combat skills feed combat power through prayers, potions, familiars, Slayer unlocks, crafting requirements, Invention, Archaeology relics and Dungeoneering rewards.
records.name: Non-combat skills feed combat power through prayers, potions, familiars, Slayer unlocks, crafting requirements, Invention, Archaeology relics and Dungeoneering rewards.

records.description: Permanent combat progression spans abilities, Necromancy talents, Invention perks, potions, prayers, Archaeology relics, task-set rewards, quest unlocks, Livid Farm, War's Retreat, enchantments, animal perks and miscellaneous account unlocks.
records.name: Permanent combat progression spans abilities, Necromancy talents, Invention perks, potions, prayers, Archaeology relics, task-set rewards, quest unlocks, Livid Farm, War's Retreat, enchantments, animal perks and miscellaneous account unlocks.

records.description: Quest dependencies worth joining to the region graph include combat ultimates, spellbooks, curses, Seren spells/prayers, Ancient Magicks additions, mobility/utility abilities and encounter access.
records.name: Quest dependencies worth joining to the region graph include combat ultimates, spellbooks, curses, Seren spells/prayers, Ancient Magicks additions, mobility/utility abilities and encounter access.

records.name: Slayer points are both a reroll/consumable resource and a permanent-unlock currency. Assignment streak milestones and Slayer-master access affect point routing.
